items.item_text: Active Physical Therapy Assistant (PTA) license in the State of California
Basic Life Support – Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (BLS-CPR) within thirty (30) days of hire
One (1) Year Of Acute Care Or Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) experience within the last five (5) years
Assist in the administration of physician-ordered physical therapy treatment for mobility, strength, pain control, and range of motion, adhering to infection control policies.
Teach patients and/or caregivers in functional activities and treatment techniques of physical therapy to meet their needs.

Administer manual exercises, instruct, encourage, and assist patients in performing physical activities, and competently administer physical therapy treatments such as applying heat/cold/moist packs, massages, and using therapeutic equipment under PT direction.
Communicate patient progress toward goals and rehabilitative potential to the supervising licensed Physical Therapist and other healthcare team members, notifying them of any unanticipated changes.
Maintain accurate patient records and progress notes, collaborating with the licensed Physical Therapist to ensure the treatment plan is followed and carried out.
Adhere to the standards of conduct and professional code of ethics promulgated by the American Physical Therapy Association for a registered Physical Therapist Assistant.
Graduate of an accredited physical therapy assistant program
